builds.name: Reference: Protection specialist
builds.goal: Reference for Seraphine: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A team-oriented ranged mage who sequences echoes, combines control with allied effects and consumes notes through a ranged attack. Grouping amplifies her shielding and ultimate reach. Record Echo readiness, ally notes and pre-existing slows/roots for E upgrades. Grouped shielding/R reach cannot be assumed during a solo-target damage test. Healing/shield power and timed actives test preserving an allied carry.
testPlan: Kit question for Seraphine: Record Echo readiness, ally notes and pre-existing slows/roots for E upgrades. Grouped shielding/R reach cannot be assumed during a solo-target damage test.

Start with the early core (Support quest, Moonstone only with useful eligible heals/shields, then the needed active) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Healing/shield power and timed actives test preserving an allied carry. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Seraphine deals damage in an area. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Only eligible heals/shields benefit; carrying too many actives can reduce practical value.

The route fails Seraphine's stated kit question: Record Echo readiness, ally notes and pre-existing slows/roots for E upgrades. Grouped shielding/R reach cannot be assumed during a solo-target damage test.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Only eligible heals/shields benefit; carrying too many actives can reduce practical value.
Full cost 10,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Support quest, Moonstone only with useful eligible heals/shields, then the needed active. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Redemption, Mikael's Blessing, Dawncore are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them [(0.2 + (0.0002) × AP) × (0.4)] Move Speed, herself [0.2 + (0.0002) × AP] decaying Move Speed and both [(60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 + (0.2) × AP) × (1)] Shield for [2.5] seconds.

If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring [8 / 10 / 12 / 14 / 16]% missing Health to them after a [2.5] second delay.

Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by [99]% for [1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5] seconds.

Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned.

Seraphine projects a pure note, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage, increased against champions and monsters by the target's missing Health percentage up to [(60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.4) × AP) × (1.75)] damage below [25]% Health.

Every third basic Ability Seraphine casts will echo, automatically casting a second time.

Additionally, Seraphine draws inspiration from the music within her allies, creating a Note for each nearby ally whenever she casts an Ability. For each Note, Seraphine's Attacks gain [25] Attack Range and deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(4 → 25; raw flags preserved) + (0.04) × AP] magic damage and consume the Notes.

Seraphine takes the stage, projecting a captivating force that Charms for [1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75] seconds and deals [150 / 200 / 250 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

Any champions struck (including allies) become part of the performance, extending the range of this Ability. Allied champions gain maximum Notes.
